artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is structurally coherent (lines and paragraphs) but semantically meaningless/gibberish upon close inspection. This is a common AI artifact where text simulation fails at the character level. However, given the low resolution, it mimics 'blur' effectively, so severity is moderate.

The labels on the blue and yellow keys are indistinct smudges rather than crisp characters or symbols. The geometry of the keys is slightly irregular, with some merging into the surrounding casing more than physically likely for molded plastic.
The black protrusion at the top left (likely an antenna or scanner head) lacks a clear connection point to the main body and appears to float or melt slightly into the casing edge.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In low-resolution images, real text can look like blobs. However, AI often generates 'pseudo-text' that has the rhythm of language but no valid characters. Use the image_text_auditor's output to determine if this is a failure of generation or just compression. Also, verify if the keypad layout is physically plausible for an industrial scanner (which often uses non-QWERTY layouts) to avoid false positives on the 'QWERTY' checkpoint.
